options.content:
Big Data · UPeU 2026-2 · Grupo 3 · Tablero ejecutivo
CryptoPulse BTC · SOL
¿Cómo anticipar, con 5 a 30 minutos de antelación, volatilidad alta, caídas fuertes, actividad anómala y desacople entre BTC y SOL?
Operación del pipeline →Estado JSON →Kafka UI →
Volatilidad · FranckCaídas · JulmerActividad · AbdulDivergencia · Luz Milagros

panels.title: Estado integral del producto
panels.description: LISTO exige productor y driver recientes, continuidad de 61 velas en ambos activos, siete pronósticos de la versión activa con menos de 3 minutos y retraso acotado. Un contenedor activo no basta.

panels.title: BTCUSDT · cierre de 1 minuto
panels.description: Último cierre confirmado; verificar frescura antes de usarlo. USDT es el activo de cotización.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time,close::double precision AS value FROM market_candles WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT' AND source_mode<>'replay' ORDER BY open_ms DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: SOLUSDT · cierre de 1 minuto
panels.description: Último cierre confirmado; verificar frescura antes de usarlo. USDT es el activo de cotización.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time,close::double precision AS value FROM market_candles WHERE symbol='SOLUSDT' AND source_mode<>'replay' ORDER BY open_ms DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Pronósticos vigentes · objetivo 7/7
panels.description: BTC y SOL: volatilidad, caída y anomalía; un pronóstico conjunto SOL−BTC. Frescura máxima: 180 segundos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time,count(*)::double precision AS value FROM cp_signal_board WHERE kind='forecast' AND age_seconds<=180

panels.title: Frescura y continuidad por activo

targets.rawSql: SELECT symbol AS "Activo",status AS "Estado",round(candle_age_seconds,1) AS "Edad vela · s",context_rows AS "Velas contexto / 61",missing_minutes AS "Minutos faltantes",round(kpi_age_seconds,1) AS "Edad indicadores · s",to_timestamp(last_close/1000.0) AS "Último cierre" FROM cp_asset_health ORDER BY symbol

panels.title: Riesgo actual · cada pronóstico como % de su umbral de alerta
panels.description: 100 % significa que el pronóstico alcanzó su umbral de alerta (P95 histórico o el umbral elegido en validación). Verde por debajo de 80 %, ámbar entre 80 % y 100 %, rojo desde 100 %.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE dimension WHEN 'volatility' THEN 'Volatilidad' WHEN 'crash' THEN 'Caída' WHEN 'anomaly' THEN 'Actividad' ELSE 'Divergencia' END||' · '||symbol AS "Serie",round((100*value/NULLIF(threshold,0))::numeric,1) AS "% del umbral" FROM cp_signal_board WHERE kind='forecast' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cómo leer este tablero

options.content:
1. Comprueba **LISTO** y **7/7**. 2. Mira el **riesgo actual** y la línea de tiempo de señales. 3. Abre la dimensión de cada integrante.  
**NORMAL** = sin cruce · **VIGILANCIA / ALERTA** = cruce real del umbral · **SIN EVALUAR / DESACTUALIZADO** = no interpretar como ausencia de riesgo. Las señales apoyan la revisión; no ejecutan órdenes.

panels.title: Centro de señales · diagnóstico y revisión
Línea de tiempo de señales · pronósticos por dimensión y activo
panels.description: Cada franja es una serie pronosticada. Verde NORMAL, ámbar VIGILANCIA, rojo ALERTA. Permite ver de un vistazo cuándo y dónde subió el riesgo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,CASE dimension WHEN 'volatility' THEN 'Volatilidad' WHEN 'crash' THEN 'Caída' WHEN 'anomaly' THEN 'Actividad' ELSE 'Divergencia' END||' · '||symbol AS metric,CASE WHEN triggered AND severity='high' THEN 2 WHEN triggered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM market_signals WHERE kind='forecast' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Señales de mercado · estado, umbral y explicación
panels.description: Siempre muestra las 14 evaluaciones posibles. NORMAL no es un dato ausente. Probabilidades en escala 0–1; las unidades figuran en cada fila. Señales observadas y predictivas se distinguen explícitamente.

targets.rawSql: SELECT symbol AS "Activo",CASE dimension WHEN 'volatility' THEN 'Volatilidad' WHEN 'crash' THEN 'Caída' WHEN 'anomaly' THEN 'Actividad' ELSE 'Divergencia' END AS "Dimensión",CASE kind WHEN 'observed' THEN 'Observada' ELSE 'Pronóstico' END AS "Origen",state AS "Estado",round(value::numeric,5) AS "Valor",round(threshold::numeric,5) AS "Umbral",unit AS "Unidad",round(age_seconds::numeric,0) AS "Edad · s",explanation AS "Interpretación",action AS "Qué revisar" FROM cp_signal_board ORDER BY dimension,symbol,kind

panels.title: Historial de cruces · período seleccionado
panels.description: Solo cruces reales. Muestra una explicación cuando no hay alertas; no confundir un vacío histórico con salud del pipeline.

targets.rawSql:
WITH events AS (SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS "Fecha",symbol AS "Activo",dimension AS "Dimensión",kind AS "Origen",CASE severity WHEN 'high' THEN 'ALERTA' ELSE 'VIGILANCIA' END AS "Estado",value AS "Valor",threshold AS "Umbral",explanation AS "Detalle",action AS "Qué revisar",model_version AS "Versión" FROM market_signals WHERE triggered AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY as_of_ms DESC LIMIT 100)
 SELECT * FROM events UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'BTC / SOL','Todas','Estado',CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM cp_signal_board WHERE kind='forecast' AND age_seconds<=180)=7 THEN 'SIN CRUCES' ELSE 'REVISAR INFERENCIA' END,NULL,NULL,'No hay señales que superen umbrales en el período seleccionado. Comprueba el estado actual arriba.','No se generan alertas artificiales para llenar esta tabla.',NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events)

panels.title: Mercado en vivo · velas de 1 minuto
BTCUSDT · velas japonesas y volumen
panels.description: Velas reales de Binance recibidas por Kafka. Verde: cierre mayor que la apertura; rojo: menor. Barras inferiores: volumen del minuto.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(open_ms/1000.0) AS time,open::double precision AS open,high::double precision AS high,low::double precision AS low,close::double precision AS close,volume::double precision AS volume FROM market_candles WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT' AND source_mode<>'replay' AND (open_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY open_ms

panels.title: SOLUSDT · velas japonesas y volumen
panels.description: Velas reales de Binance recibidas por Kafka. Verde: cierre mayor que la apertura; rojo: menor. Barras inferiores: volumen del minuto.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(open_ms/1000.0) AS time,open::double precision AS open,high::double precision AS high,low::double precision AS low,close::double precision AS close,volume::double precision AS volume FROM market_candles WHERE symbol='SOLUSDT' AND source_mode<>'replay' AND (open_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY open_ms

panels.title: Cuatro dimensiones · un integrante por dimensión
Volatilidad · Franck · observada y futura a 15 min
panels.description: Volatilidad realizada = 100√Σ(log-retorno²), sin anualizar. Línea continua: observada; punteada: pronóstico; puntos: realidad posterior, que solo existe tras 15 minutos completos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,symbol||' · observada reciente' AS metric,observed AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='volatility' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) UNION ALL SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,symbol||' · pronóstico' AS metric,forecast AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='volatility' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) UNION ALL SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,symbol||' · realidad futura' AS metric,actual AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='volatility' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) AND actual IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Caída fuerte · Julmer · probabilidad a 30 min
panels.description: Probabilidad de rendimiento al cierre de 30 minutos bajo P5 histórico: BTC −0,558 %; SOL −1,116 %. Umbral de alerta elegido en validación: 5,8 %. Modelo limitado: consultar precisión y recall históricos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,symbol||' · pronóstico' AS metric,forecast AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='crash' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Actividad anómala · Abdul · probabilidad a 5 min
panels.description: Probabilidad de superar P95 de volumen u operaciones en los siguientes 5 minutos, por activo y hora UTC. La anomalía observada se muestra separada en el centro de señales.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,symbol||' · pronóstico' AS metric,forecast AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='anomaly' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Separación BTC–SOL · Luz Milagros · tamaño |SOL − BTC| a 15 min
panels.description: Tamaño de la separación |SOL − BTC| en puntos porcentuales, sin signo. Línea continua: observada; punteada: pronóstico; puntos: realidad posterior. La referencia es el promedio histórico de entrenamiento.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,symbol||' · observada reciente' AS metric,observed AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='divergence' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) UNION ALL SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,symbol||' · pronóstico' AS metric,forecast AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='divergence' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) UNION ALL SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,symbol||' · realidad futura' AS metric,actual AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='divergence' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) AND actual IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Correlación BTC / SOL · rendimientos 60 min
panels.description: Pearson sobre rendimientos consecutivos de un minuto: −1 a +1. Correlación no implica causalidad.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,(metrics->>'correlation_60m')::double precision AS value FROM market_kpis WHERE symbol='BTC-SOL' AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Actividad observada · referencia por hora UTC
panels.description: P95 y Z score respecto del entrenamiento 2022–2024 para activo/hora UTC. Comprueba frescura arriba; no atribuye fraude.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON(symbol) symbol AS "Activo",to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS "Cierre",round((metrics->>'quote5')::numeric,0) AS "USDT · 5 min",round((metrics->>'quote5_p95')::numeric,0) AS "USDT · P95",(metrics->>'trades5')::bigint AS "Operaciones · 5 min",round((metrics->>'trades5_p95')::numeric,0) AS "Operaciones · P95",round((metrics->>'volume_zscore')::numeric,2) AS "Z volumen" FROM market_kpis WHERE symbol IN ('BTCUSDT','SOLUSDT') ORDER BY symbol,as_of_ms DESC

panels.title: Evidencia de utilidad · batch y en vivo lado a lado
Batch · prueba histórica reservada, modelo contra referencia
panels.description: Prueba enero–septiembre 2026, muestreo cada 15 min. MAE/RMSE en unidad de su objetivo; Brier menor es mejor. Precisión y recall son proporciones. No se reentrena con esta prueba para escoger modelos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.dimension AS "Dimensión",m.method AS "Método desplegado",(m.metrics->>'n')::bigint AS "Casos",(m.metrics->>'mae')::float AS "MAE",(m.metrics->>'rmse')::float AS "RMSE",(b.metrics->>'rmse')::float AS "RMSE referencia",(m.metrics->>'pr_auc')::float AS "PR AUC",(m.metrics->>'brier')::float AS "Brier",(b.metrics->>'brier')::float AS "Brier referencia",(m.metrics->>'precision')::float AS "Precisión",(m.metrics->>'recall')::float AS "Recall",m.model_version AS "Versión" FROM model_metrics m JOIN model_metrics b ON b.dimension=m.dimension AND b.model_version=m.model_version AND b.split='test_baseline' WHERE m.split='test_deployed' AND m.model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') ORDER BY m.dimension

panels.title: En vivo · error real de los pronósticos ya madurados
panels.description: Solo la versión activa y el período elegido. Los horizontes todavía abiertos o con datos incompletos permanecen pendientes. Clasificación usa Brier; no se mezcla con RMSE de precios.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dimension AS "Dimensión",symbol AS "Activo",count(*) AS "Emitidas",count(actual) AS "Evaluadas",count(*) FILTER(WHERE actual IS NULL) AS "Pendientes",avg(abs(forecast-actual)) FILTER(WHERE dimension IN ('volatility','divergence')) AS "MAE regresión",sqrt(avg(power(forecast-actual,2)) FILTER(WHERE dimension IN ('volatility','divergence'))) AS "RMSE regresión",avg(power(forecast-actual,2)) FILTER(WHERE dimension IN ('crash','anomaly')) AS "Brier clasificación",avg(power(baseline-actual,2)) AS "MSE referencia" FROM predictions WHERE source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) GROUP BY dimension,symbol ORDER BY dimension,symbol

panels.title: Eventos empresariales · operaciones ejecutadas (Kafka → Spark, ventana 1 min)
Flujo neto comprador − vendedor por minuto
panels.description: Cada operación de Binance (aggTrade) es un evento empresarial publicado en Kafka (market.trades.*). Spark agrupa por minuto con watermark de 1 min y deduplicación por event_id. Positivo: dominaron las compras agresivas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time,symbol||' · flujo neto' AS metric,buy_usdt-sell_usdt AS value FROM trade_flow WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Presión compradora · % del importe iniciado por compradores
panels.description: 50 % es equilibrio. Valores sostenidos lejos de 50 % acompañan movimientos direccionales; contrastar con caídas y volatilidad.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time,symbol AS metric,100*buy_usdt/NULLIF(buy_usdt+sell_usdt,0) AS value FROM trade_flow WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Último minuto cerrado · operaciones por activo
panels.description: Ventanas finalizadas por watermark: aparecen con 1–2 minutos de retraso respecto al reloj.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol AS "Activo",window_end AS "Cierre",trades AS "Operaciones",round(buy_usdt::numeric,0) AS "Compras USDT",round(sell_usdt::numeric,0) AS "Ventas USDT",large_trades AS "Operaciones ≥ 100k USDT",round(max_trade_usdt::numeric,0) AS "Mayor operación USDT" FROM trade_flow ORDER BY symbol,window_start DESC

target.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM registered_at)*1000 AS time,'Modelo activo: '||model_version AS text,'modelo' AS tags FROM model_versions WHERE $__timeFilter(registered_at)

SELECT as_of_ms AS time,'ALERTA · '||CASE dimension WHEN 'volatility' THEN 'Volatilidad' WHEN 'crash' THEN 'Caída' WHEN 'anomaly' THEN 'Actividad' ELSE 'Divergencia' END||' · '||symbol AS text,'alerta' AS tags FROM market_signals WHERE triggered AND severity='high' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000)
